recovery.recognizedIntermediate: Roll forward to the complete deterministic after-image.
recovery.corruptAfter: Restore both complete valid before-images, clear pending state, and record RECOVERED_ROLLBACK_CORRUPT_AFTER.
recovery.corruptBefore: Retain the journal, mark compactionRepairRequired, place the cell in REPAIR, and fail closed.
recovery.idempotency: A second recovery scan makes no additional memory changes and creates no second final commit receipt.

authorityBoundary.statement: Memory arrays, journals, compaction generations, receipts, and repair state are non-canonical. All tested normal, interrupted, recovered, rollback, and repair-lock paths preserve the canonical hash.

claimBoundary: Interruptions are deterministic in-process fault injections captured through JSON persistence.
This does not test process termination during the physical act of writing a snapshot file.
This does not prove atomic filesystem replacement, fsync durability, or power-loss safety.
A corrupt-before journal cannot be automatically reconstructed without another trusted source.
No compaction performance or massive-world scaling claim is established.
